bib_record.title: Neutron cross-section measurements on structural materials at ORELA

free_txt: The neutron detector was an 11.1 cm
positioned in the beam at 79.815 m from the neutron
source. The scintillator was viewed on edge by two
12.7 cm diameter photomultipliers that were placed
outside the neutron beam to decrease backgrounds. For
gamma-ray measurements, a pair of deuterated benzene
enriched 53Cr,48Ti and natural chromium and titanium
were performed at ORELA. The neutron transmission and
capture cross section were measured in the energy
range from 10 keV to 600 keV. The transmission data
were measured at the 79.815 m flight station. The
neutron capture experiments were performed at the 40
m flight station of ORELA utilizing flight paths 6
and 7. the employed experimental technique was the
